resourceName: Hubei Xingshan IFM (conversion of logged to protected forest) Project
description:
The Hubei Xingshan IFM (conversion of logged to protected forest) Project  (hereafter “the project activity”) is implemented in Xingshan County, Yichang City, Hubei Province  of China by Xingshan County Economic Development Investment Co., Ltd., the geo-coordinate of the  project  proponent is  110°25'E -111°06'E and 31°04'N - 31°34'N,  the total area is 231524.71 ha, which includes  the  Improved  Forest  Management  (IFM)  of  the forests in the conversion of logged to protected forest.
The area of the project activity is 5377.39ha, including 921 subcompartments spreading over Gufu Town, Huangliang Town, Shuiyuesi Town, Xiakou Town, Zhaojun Town, Nanyang Town, Gaoqiao Township, Zhenzi Township,Longmenhe Township, Houping Township, Fentangping Township of Xingshan County. All these forests are state-owned forests or privately-owned or collective-owned, and have the legal right to forest ownership. The species involved in the project are Pinus massoniana, Broadleaf Mix,Quercus and Bashan Pinus.
Before the implementation of the project activity, the trees are logged based on a valid and verifiable government-approved timber management plan for harvesting the project area. The implementation of the project activity converses the trees to protected forest to reduce the GHG emissions for about 980,952 tCO2e in 20 years, the average annual emission reduction is 40,508 tCO2e and Verified Carbon Units with buffer deduction is about 804,380 tCO2e in 20 years, and average annual VCUs with buffer deduction is 33,216 tCO2e. 
The project activity will contribute to the environment (biodiversity conservation, rocky desertification prevention and soil erosion control), thus contribute to sustainable development.
